units: <cite ref="Gittin 56b:7">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>אשקוהו מיא דפ׳</he> they gave him bran water to drink.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 92b:1">B. Bath. 92ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>מן מרי רשותך פ׳ איפרע</he> from a debtor of thine accept (even) bran in payment; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 46b:1">B. Kam. 46ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 118a:10">B. Mets. 118ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 111b:12">Pes. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ בביתא קשי לעניותא</he> bran scattered in the house is bad for (brings) poverty.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 8b:17">Bekh. 8ᵇ</cite> (in a facetious conversation, v. <cite ref="B00133"><he>בְּדִיאֵי</he></cite>) <he>אפשילו לי חבלי מפ׳ וכ׳</he> twist me ropes of bran, and &c.
